Project explainer · agent-authored-recap

A smaller path to a trustworthy explainer

The project replaces callback orchestration with one host-agent authoring step, surrounded by deterministic bundling, verification, and recording. The result serves lifecycle callers and direct human use through the same recipe-driven flow.

One authored page A self-contained artifact rather than an adaptive portfolio.
Traceable facts A cited bundle and bounded ledger constrain machine-checkable claims.
Layered confidence Browser evidence augments checks that run on every host.
System shape

Planned architecture

Lifecycle callers and the human front door resolve a recipe, inputs, theme, output root, and intent. The core then prepares evidence for the host agent, verifies the authored page, and records an exact-inventory package. The adapter remains a thin OAT-specific boundary.

Core boundary

Recipe-neutral scripts collect explicit inputs and never read OAT, user, vault, or destination configuration.

Adapter boundary

OAT-specific resolution stays outside the core and forwards a prepared request into the same flow.

Package boundary

The manifest binds every retained artifact byte and the inventory admits no unrecorded file.

Load-bearing choices

Decisions

Choice Why Alternative set aside Consequence
Host-agent authoring The active agent already has project context and can apply the recipe brief directly. Injected author and critic callbacks. Authoring becomes legible prose rather than provider plumbing.
One small run package Every retained file has a named reader and immutable byte evidence. Durability receipts and publication records. The archive export is the durable copy.
Bounded claim checking Mechanical checks can reliably trace terms, dates, counts, and lifecycle words when subject and value stay together. A universal prose-fidelity checker. Narrative judgment remains with the author; objective anchors fail visibly.
Runtime browser ladder Hosts vary, but browser absence must not block a usable artifact. A configured provider-specific browser seam. The result always says which evidence rung was reached.
Failure modes

Risks

Claim extraction drifts

Trigger: the page separates a machine-readable value from its source subject.

Impact: verification rejects a grounded page.

Mitigation: keep subject and value together and test against captured real material.

Visual confidence is overstated

Trigger: capture is mistaken for inspection.

Impact: a layout defect receives a stronger outcome than its evidence supports.

Mitigation: bind screenshots to artifact bytes and require an inspected verdict or automated findings.

Lifecycle vocabulary diverges

Trigger: a caller keeps a retired seam or outcome.

Impact: closeout and archive behavior disagree.

Mitigation: use shared contract tests and a repository-wide retired-reference sweep.

Deliberate limit

The browser-less rung permits delivery with an explicit request for human review. It does not pretend that static checks establish visual quality.

Dependency order

Delivery phases

Delivery is deliberately sequential because each slice changes the core tree or a consumer of the preceding contract.

Phase Purpose Observable condition
p01 Cut to the new core flow and package contract. Real material traverses bundle, author, verify, record.
p02 Add browser rungs and fresh-host assurance. Captured evidence is byte-bound and fallback is visible.
p03 Move adapters, lifecycle callers, and docs. Live surfaces share one vocabulary and retired paths vanish.
p04 Add the human front door and prove this explainer. Direct inputs and approved project artifacts produce packages.
p05 Generate the execution-program recap. The program ledger names its run identity and outcome.
Evidence strategy

Validation approach

Flow behavior

Focused end-to-end tests exercise every input mode, missing arguments, visible pre-record failures, and satisfied reuse.

Artifact truth

Required narrative, source discipline, script safety, and both claim directions run before browser evidence is considered.

Package assurance

Contract validation, byte verification, and exact inventory checks are paired with safely corrupted disposable controls.

Repository composition

Type, test, build, skill, release, documentation, lint, and format gates protect the integrated tree.

Fact anchors carried by the plan

These bounded anchors keep the generated artifact mechanically tied to its prepared evidence without copying the source documents.
